title: Role-based action buttons (Primary/Secondary/Tertiary)

Canonical defaults: Primary=LShift+PadA (P2=RShift), Secondary=Space+PadB, Tertiary=LCtrl+PadX. Keep game-flavored labels and stable names so saved bindings survive; only defaults change. Confirmed: Primary=Shift uniformly (Fire moves off Space), typed InputKind roles, keep labels.
close_reason: Role-based action buttons implemented across core/frontend/machines with tests; build, clippy (no new warnings), fmt, and full test suite green.

close_reason: Added ActionRole {Primary,Secondary,Tertiary}, InputKind::Action(ActionRole), and ActionRole::default_bindings(player) returning the canonical SDL-free defaults (Primary LShift+PadA / P2 RShift, Secondary Space+PadB, Tertiary LCtrl+PadX).

No change to apply_overrides/to_serialized/rebind.

Designs: docs/designs/address-space-refactor.md (AddressSpace32), docs/designs/debug-observability.md (Address Width section). Blocked by epics 2 and 3.
close_reason: All 3 subtasks complete: AddressSpace32/AddressMap32 + BE/word-bus helpers (hqy.1), DebugCpu/BusDebug surface widened u16->u32 (hqy.2), debug UI widened to u32 (hqy.3). Unblocks the remove-compat-aliases epic (9vp).

close_reason: AddressMap32 (sorted non-overlapping ranges, binary search), AddressSpace32 (map + MemoryBacking + Watchpoints, DebugRead/DebugWrite peek/poke), big-endian u8/u16/u32 helpers + word-bus adapters; no implicit 24-bit masking. Landed as 3 commits with 45 tests.

title: debug-obs: rich WatchpointHit metadata + phase (consume canonical type)

close_reason: Rich WatchpointHit metadata implemented: cycle/pc latched per-tick into AddressSpace16 (boards can't read CPU state mid-tick), populated alongside source/region; device attribution via watch_*_with (Williams pilot: Widget/ROM/Sound PIA, Blitter); WatchpointPhase derived from kind with all boards checking write watchpoints before side effects; debug UI shows source/value/phase/region/device/cycle/PC. 4 commits, all tests + clippy clean.

title: debug-obs: DebugEvent/DebugTrace + DebugTraceBuffer + #[debug_events] derive; Williams pilot

close_reason: DebugEvent/DebugEventKind/DebugTraceBuffer (4096-event ring, disabled by default, static-str detail) + DebugTrace capability added to FrontendMachine bundle with no-op defaults. #[derive(DebugTrace)] with #[debug_events] field attribute. title: debug-obs: broaden instrumentation (Namco Pac, TKG-04, Atari vector, Galaga/DigDug)

close_reason: All four board families instrumented: Namco Pac (I/O latch/WSG/sprite/watchdog events + VBLANK IRQ), TKG-04 (sound latch/IRQ, NMI mask, i8257 sprite DMA with byte counts), Atari DVG+AVG (vector generator start/reset, watchdog, periodic NMI/IRQ), and Galaga/Dig Dug — which also gained the Watchpoints support they lacked: board-level Watchpoints set with per-CPU PC latching across 3 Z80s, BusDebug watchpoint overrides, and 06XX/51XX/53XX custom-chip transaction events. 9 wrappers now delegate DebugTrace. 4 commits, 20 new tests, clippy clean.

title: Missile Command: emulate + expose the R8 game-options DIP bank
description: Missile Command has two physical DIP banks: R10 (pricing, read at 0x4A00 — already exposed via DipSwitches as bank 0) and R8 (game options: Cities, Bonus City, Trackball Size, Bonus-credit-for-4-coins, Cabinet — read at 0x4000 via POKEY in MAME). The emulator currently only stores/reads the R10 byte, so R8 isn't settable. Add an R8 dip byte field, wire its bus read, and expose it as a second DipSwitchBank using MAME's missile R8 layout (verbatim values in the jvq.6 notes). Defaults must preserve current behavior. Not a DipSwitches-trait limitation — the trait already supports multiple banks (see Tempest/DigDug/Galaga).

title: Global P pause key
description: Press P to pause/unpause the whole emulation (frontend-level control, not a game input). Reuse the existing RunMode::Paused plumbing via a global_paused flag; audio naturally goes silent (callback holds last sample, no buzzing). Show an on-screen PAUSED indicator on both raster and vector render paths.

title: frontend: add global_paused to DebugState + honor in execute_frame
description: debug_ui.rs: add global_paused: bool (default false) to DebugState. In execute_frame, on the !state.active path: if global_paused return false (no run_frame, no audio drain); else run_frame. When debug UI active, run_mode governs and global_paused is ignored.

title: frontend: bind P to toggle pause in emulator event loop
description: emulator.rs: add a hardcoded KeyDown { scancode: P, repeat: false } match arm alongside F12/Tab (before the catch-all that forwards to machine.handle_input) toggling debug_state.global_paused, with a stderr Paused/Resumed log. P is not bound by any game.

Vector (DVG: Asteroids/AstDelux/Tempest/Lunar): draw PAUSED in the egui overlay closure of the vector present path.

title: DIP reference machines: namco_pac/pacman + digdug + tests
description: Implement real DipSwitches for the two reference patterns: single board-owned byte (namco_pac.rs + pacman.rs, field dip_switches) and two bytes (digdug.rs, dswa/dswb as one bank each). Define &'static [DipSwitchBank] tables whose default-equivalent bytes match today's hardcoded values (0xC9 pacman, 0x99/0x24 digdug). Unit tests: set_dip_option mutates the right bits only; dip_bank_value round-trips; defaults == historical bytes.
close_reason: Implemented real DipSwitches for both reference patterns: Pac-Man single board-owned byte (namco_pac::DIP_BANKS shared table + pacman.rs impl over board.dip_switches) and Dig Dug two bytes (DIGDUG_DIP_BANKS two-bank table over board.dswa/dswb). Tables follow MAME pacman/digdug layouts; per-option defaults reconstruct historical 0xC9 / 0x99 / 0x24. 10 unit tests cover defaults==historical, well-formed metadata, default decomposition, set_dip_option masking, and bank round-trip. Workspace builds, clippy/fmt clean.

close_reason: Added settings_ui::draw_dip_panel (collapsing headers per bank, ComboBox per option, selection decoded from dip_bank_value & mask, OnReset note) and wired into emulator.rs: backtick toggle gated on has_dip, panels_width/resize for the stacking panel, DIP bytes snapshotted pre-closure, edits buffered in SettingsState::pending_dip_changes and applied via set_dip_option after the frame (mirrors pending_device_actions). title: DIP persistence: per-machine state.toml load/apply/save

close_reason: state.rs gains dip_switches: HashMap<String, Vec<u8>> keyed by machine_id (one byte per bank, serde default). main.rs snapshots power-on DIP bytes, applies persisted overrides via set_dip_bank_value before the first reset() so OnReset latches, and on exit persists current bank bytes (dropping entries equal to defaults, mirroring input_bindings). Verified reset_board does not clobber the DIP byte. Builds, clippy/fmt clean.

close_reason: Rolled real DipSwitches onto 12 of 13 machines with MAME-verified tables (defaults reconstruct the historical hardcoded bytes): dkong, dkongjr (tkg04 dsw0); galaga (namco_galaga dswa/dswb); asteroids, astdelux, llander (Atari vector dip byte via 74LS253 mux); tempest (dsw1/dsw2); foodf (POKEY pots); gridlee (0x9600); missile (R10 pricing); ccastles (Cabinet via POKEY2 ALLPOT); qbert (gottlieb flat DSW). EXCEPTION: satans_hollow left empty-with-doc — its only DIP is the SSIO sound board's 8 switches (read at 0xF000), which MAME treats as IPT_UNKNOWN for all MCR games (coinage interpreted by sound ROM firmware, no documented per-bit layout); not modelable without firmware RE. Workspace builds, clippy/fmt clean, all machine tests pass.

title: Fix Tempest sound
description: Tempest sound output doesn't sound correct. Needs investigation and fixing.
close_reason: Fixed: POKEY channel output now latched at the channel underflow (commit a3dfd59) instead of sampling the polynomial at the 1.79 MHz master clock, which made all noise/distortion SFX harsh; plus the 1.79 MHz divider offset (AUDF+4 / AUDF16+7). Noise sounds now use the correct POKEY texture.

title: Motorola 68000 CPU emulator
description: Add a Motorola 68000 CPU emulator following the same structure as the 6809/6502/Z80 cores, architected so 68010/68020/(maybe)68030 variants can be layered on later via a variant field. Word bus model (Bus<Address=u32, Data=u16>), atomic (i8088-style) execution, TomHarte 680x0 SingleStepTests as the correctness gate. Design: docs/designs/m68000-emulator.md. This epic tracks M1 (foundation) as reviewable-sized child commits plus M2-M7 follow-ups.
close_reason: All 14 subtasks complete: M1 foundation through M7 full TomHarte validation (1,000,058/1,000,060 vectors) plus the M6 disassembler. 68000 core is feature-complete.

title: m68000: CPU skeleton + registration
description: Create core/src/cpu/m68000/mod.rs: M68000 struct (d[8], a[8], usp, ssp, pc, sr, variant, exec temporaries) with #[derive(Saveable)] #[save_version(1)]; M68kVariant enum (M68000/10/20/30, only M68000 behavior); ExecState { Fetch, Execute(u32), Stopped, Halted }; stub execute_cycle + execute_instruction dispatch; BusMasterComponent/Cpu/CpuStateTrait/Debuggable/DebugCpu impls; Cpu::reset loads SSP from vector 0 and PC from vector 1. Add M68000State to core/src/cpu/state.rs (D0-7,A0-7,USP,SSP,PC,SR + debug_registers()). Register module in core/src/cpu/mod.rs (+ state re-export) and re-export M68000 in core/src/lib.rs. Builds, clippy+fmt clean.
close_reason: M68000 skeleton: struct, M68kVariant, ExecState, reset via vectors 0/1, all trait impls, M68000State, module registration

title: m68000 M3: branches/jumps/subroutines

close_reason: M3 complete: BRA/BSR/Bcc (disp8+disp16), DBcc with Dn.w loop counter, JMP/JSR over control EA modes, RTS/RTR via cc_true; TomHarte gate widened by 7 files (Bcc/BSR/DBcc/JMP/JSR/RTS/RTR) — 575,801 passed, 0 failed; 21 integration tests; decode_ea now returns full 32-bit EAs (bus masks to 24) so JMP/JSR load unmasked PC like hardware

title: m68000 M4: bit ops, MOVEM, LEA/PEA/LINK/UNLK
description: bit.rs: BTST/BSET/BCLR/BCHG (imm + Dn dynamic; bit mod 32 reg / mod 8 mem). stack.rs: LEA, PEA, LINK/UNLK, MOVEM (both directions, predecrement reversal), SWAP, EXG, ADDQ/SUBQ. Widen skip-list. Tests.
close_reason: M4 complete across four commits: BTST/BCHG/BCLR/BSET (dynamic + static, mod 32 reg / mod 8 mem), ADDQ/SUBQ + SWAP/EXG, LEA/PEA/LINK/UNLK (LINK A7 pushes decremented SP), MOVEM both directions with predec mask reversal and the 68000 base-register-in-list rules; TomHarte gate widened by 12 files and the ADDQ/SUBQ per-opcode skip removed — 677,799 passed, 0 failed across 105 files; 47 new integration tests (212 total)

title: m68000 M5: exceptions/interrupts/privilege
description: exception.rs: vector dispatch, supervisor SP swap, 68000 short stack frame (gated on variant), TRAP/TRAPV/CHK/divide-by-zero/illegal/line-A/line-F/privilege/address-error, RTE, interrupt sampling at boundary + level masking + autovector, STOP/RESET. notes: Decision (2026-06-10): MAME 0.148 cross-validation dropped for the m68000. TomHarte is the stronger oracle: hardware-verified state vectors incl. undefined flags, plus cycle counts and per-cycle bus transactions (length/transactions fields, currently unused) if cycle-accurate timing validation is ever wanted. MAME 0.148 is demonstrably weaker on exactly the interesting cases (SBCD/NBCD V approximation, ASR past-width C/X, DIVU/DIVS overflow flags), so every comparison mask would be 'phosphor right, MAME wrong'. title: Satan's Hollow: model the SSIO sound-board DIP (coinage)
description: Satan's Hollow's only user DIP is the SSIO sound board's 8 switches (set via ssio.set_dip_switches, read by the SSIO sound CPU at 0xF000; default 0x81). MAME treats this port as 8 IPT_UNKNOWN switches for every MCR game — the coin/option meaning is interpreted by the SSIO sound ROM, with no documented per-bit layout — so the DipSwitches impl is currently left empty (see comment in satans_hollow.rs). To expose it: derive the MCR SSIO coinage scheme (operator manual / SSIO firmware analysis) and add a DipSwitchBank, or expose the 8 raw switches as a fallback. Also consider the game-side IP3 DIPs (Coin Meters, Cabinet) which sit on a separate SSIO input port, not the persisted DIP byte.
